# Sheaffer

> Sheaffer is a premium writing instruments brand offering fountain pens, ballpoint pens, rollerball pens, and stationery across iconic collections including the 100 Series, 300 Series, and Legacy lines.

Founded in 1913 by Walter A. Sheaffer in Fort Madison, Iowa, Sheaffer has established itself as a leader in quality writing instruments. The brand offers diverse product collections ranging from accessible everyday pens to luxury writing instruments, with special collaborations and gift sets available for various occasions.

## Core Collections

- [100 Series](https://sheaffer.com/collections/sheaffer-100): Sheaffer 100 Series timeless pen collection with smart design and quality craftsmanship
- [300 Series](https://sheaffer.com/collections/300): Sheaffer 300 Series distinctive pens with iconic slotted clip and wide banding
- [Sheaffer Legacy](https://sheaffer.com/collections/sheaffer-legacy): Sheaffer Legacy premium luxury writing instruments with chrome-plated trims
- [Legacy](https://sheaffer.com/collections/legacy): Sheaffer Legacy luxury pen collection with 14K gold and premium finishes
- [Expression](https://sheaffer.com/collections/expression): Sheaffer Expression Collection with pearlised gradient finishes and chrome-plated trims
- [Coffee](https://sheaffer.com/collections/coffee): Sheaffer Coffee Collection featuring 100 and VFM series pens with coffee-themed designs
